svg.text: All traffic passes through one MQTT broker. Each device publishes only under its own username; any client may subscribe under SENG3030/#.
raw audio, Lab 4 format · on command
on / off (all of A's data) · R
• Mic records all the time (as in Lab 4)
• Hold BtnA = A's data on / off
• Hold BtnB = A sends its audio
• Shows all of A's data on the LCD
• BtnA or C's command = change page
• Pages: SHT30, QMP, IMU ×2, power, mic
• Plays each new mic clip on its speaker
• Marks data as stale after 5 s
The broker keeps the last message on this topic.
A device that subscribes later gets it at once.
Set when the device connects. If it drops off,
the broker publishes "offline" on its behalf.
"off": A stops publishing all data (audio too).
Retained, so A gets the last setting after a reboot.
"next" or "prev": B moves one page, the same as
its own button. One-shot, so it is not retained.
"send": A publishes its current audio buffer
to <A>/mic/clip. One-shot, so it is not retained.
